newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Cold Stores up 12.5 pct on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Cold Stores up 12.5 pct on retail buying.

text.p: Retail buying pushed up shares of Ceylon Cold Stores Ltd, by 12.5 percent or 15 rupees to 135 rupees in early Friday trade, brokers said.
"Retailers are hunting the share because the company has done amazingly well in the last financial year and seems like doing equally well in the current one," said a local broker.
Cold Stores, a unit of blue chip John Keells Holdings, saw net profits grow by 73 percent to 152.78 million rupees, in the financial year ended March 31, 1997.
The company has a major slice of the domestic market for processed meats, ice cream and bottled soft drinks.
